phase: MASTER UPGRADE — PART 1/12: EXISTING PROJECT AUDIT, FEATURE INVENTORY, AND NON-DESTRUCTIVE IMPLEMENTATION PLAN

architecture_confirmation.runtime: Node.js v22 (LTS) / Express 4.21 / TypeScript 7.0 / Vite 8.3 / React 19
architecture_confirmation.serverless_entry: api/index.ts -> src/api/app.ts (Pure serverless handler with zero Vite runtime coupling)
architecture_confirmation.local_fullstack_entry: server.ts (Express API + Vite Dev Middleware / Static dist on port 3000)
architecture_confirmation.database: PostgreSQL with connection pooling, automated 10-table schema migrations, and durable in-memory fallback
architecture_confirmation.deployment_config: vercel.json (V2 builder, CSP/CORS security headers, sensitive path blocking, API rewrites)

feature_inventory.name: Central Brain & Model Router
feature_inventory.authentication_requirements: Optional for read; Tenant-isolated token for orchestration plans
feature_inventory.verification_evidence: tests/central_brain_orchestration.test.ts verifies domain classification (coding vs terminal), calibrated capability scoring, DAG dependency generation, architectural constraints injection, and automatic fallback routing.

feature_inventory.name: Autonomous Bug-Bounty Hunting Platform
feature_inventory.authentication_requirements: Authenticated researcher token bound to strict tenantId
feature_inventory.verification_evidence: tests/bughunt_platform.test.ts verifies 1-Click START BUG HUNTING, CUSTOM BUG HUNT with scoped droids, 6 specialized security droids (Argus, Hydra, Aegis, Vulcan, Specter, Cerberus), scope whitelist/blacklist enforcement, cURL PoCs, SHA-256 evidence hashing, and HackerOne/Bugcrowd Markdown report generation.

feature_inventory.name: Multi-Provider Authentication & Tenant Isolation
database_dependencies: PostgreSQL users table in schema migrations
feature_inventory.authentication_requirements: Bearer JWT with tenant_id claims; PBKDF2 SHA-512 password hash
feature_inventory.verification_evidence: tests/bughunt_platform.test.ts verifies PBKDF2 100,000-iteration hashing, provider matrix status auditing, tenant boundary enforcement on workspace queries, and cross-account switching.

feature_inventory.name: Continuity & Engineering Memory Engine
feature_inventory.authentication_requirements: Tenant ID isolation with sanitized global knowledge promotion
feature_inventory.verification_evidence: tests/continuity_intelligence.test.ts verifies durable memories with 4-tier evidence statuses (VERIFIED, INFERRED, UNVERIFIED, OUTDATED), checkpoint resumption without duplicate side effects, empirical routing calibration, and CSV/JSON exports.

feature_inventory.name: Sandboxed Agent Runtime & Execution Manager
feature_inventory.verification_evidence: tests/phase1b.test.ts, tests/phase1c.test.ts, tests/phase1d.test.ts, tests/phase1f.test.ts, and tests/reality_audit.ts verify path traversal defense, timeout limits, human-in-the-loop approvals for destructive operations, global kill-switch, and execution receipts.

feature_inventory.name: Universal Isolated Terminal & Workspace VFS
feature_inventory.authentication_requirements: Workspace authorization check; dangerous host commands (exit 126) permanently forbidden
feature_inventory.verification_evidence: tests/universal_terminal_knowledge.test.ts verifies shell execution inside isolated VFS, immediate rejection of host escalation commands, approval gating for destructive commands, and audit trail persistence.

feature_inventory.name: Open-Source Resource Discovery & Learning Engine
feature_inventory.authentication_requirements: Public discovery with rate-limit tracking; GitHub token for extended quotas
feature_inventory.verification_evidence: tests/universal_terminal_knowledge.test.ts verifies multi-source discovery (GitHub, Hugging Face, npm), license extraction, rate limit auditing, and official doc-grounded learning paths.

feature_inventory.name: Autonomous Model & Pipeline Evolution Lab
feature_inventory.authentication_requirements: Operator / administrator role required for model promotion/rollback
feature_inventory.verification_evidence: tests/universal_terminal_knowledge.test.ts verifies benchmark execution, candidate comparison, canary promotion, and safe rollback.

feature_inventory.name: Review Center, QA Metrics & Security Headers
feature_inventory.authentication_requirements: Requires confirmation flag before applying safe remediation patches
feature_inventory.verification_evidence: tests/review_center.test.ts and tests/api_smoke.test.ts verify Google AI Studio iframe embedding restoration (frame-ancestors), clickjacking protection, automated fix dispatch, and test execution triggers.

feature_inventory.name: Google Workspace & Identity Services Integration
feature_inventory.authentication_requirements: Client-side Google Identity Services (GIS) token; zero server-side secret leakage
feature_inventory.classification: Partially implemented / Blocked by user interactive consent
feature_inventory.verification_evidence: Client-side GIS tokenClient initialized cleanly. Requires browser interaction with VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID for interactive token generation.

feature_inventory.name: Knowledge Graph & Resource Relationships
feature_inventory.verification_evidence: tests/phase1d.test.ts and tests/reality_audit.ts verify zero dangling graph relationships and strict demarcation between verified resources and unverified demo data.

feature_inventory.name: PostgreSQL Persistence & Serverless Pool
database_dependencies: 10 AI Heaven Postgres tables with automated migrations
feature_inventory.authentication_requirements: DATABASE_URL connection string with SSL support
feature_inventory.classification: Implemented and verified (with In-Memory Fallback when unconfigured)
feature_inventory.verification_evidence: tests/phase1f.test.ts verifies unconfigured and invalid DATABASE_URL diagnostics, credential redaction in errors, and schema migration SQL queries.

part_2_central_brain.focus: Capability registry, natural language constraints, dynamic model selection, and durable state machine (QUEUED, PLANNING, RUNNING, WAITING_APPROVAL, PAUSED, VERIFYING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED).
part_2_central_brain.regression_risks: Ensuring pre-task constraints injection does not alter existing task outcome telemetry.

part_3_authentication.focus: Expanding OAuth flows (GitHub, Hugging Face, Google) with secure server-side state/CSRF validation, account linking, and dedicated AI Accounts view.
part_3_authentication.regression_risks: Preventing token invalidation or cross-tenant leakage during multi-provider identity linking.

part_4_droidization.focus: Scaling agent workers dynamically beyond 2 workers, adding specialized task workers (Hunt Commander, Recon, SAST, Droidization for websites), and shared task context.
part_4_droidization.regression_risks: Resource starvation or task queue deadlocks under high worker concurrency.

part_5_hackerone_discovery.focus: Official HackerOne API capabilities, program discovery, rule parsing, scope snapshots, and bounty filter constraints.
part_5_hackerone_discovery.regression_risks: Graceful handling of unconfigured API credentials without crashing autonomous hunt launches.

part_6_vulnerability_discovery.focus: Advanced security testing engine, 15 vulnerability categories, rate limits, execution boundaries, and explicit target authorization enforcement.
part_6_vulnerability_discovery.regression_risks: Scope bypass or out-of-scope probes if URL parsing is non-deterministic.
part_6_vulnerability_discovery.required_tests: Run tests/bughunt_platform.test.ts scope enforcement test cases.

part_7_execution_engine.focus: Tool registry schema validation, isolated virtual containers, bounded logs, and emergency kill-switch.
part_7_execution_engine.regression_risks: Filesystem boundary escape or command injection in VFS.

part_8_independent_verification.focus: 8-tier finding classification, cryptographic evidence proofs (SHA-256), curl reproduction traces, sensitive data redaction, and Markdown report export.
part_8_independent_verification.regression_risks: Leaking credentials in curl reproduction traces if redaction regex is incomplete.

part_9_resource_discovery.focus: Knowledge graph integration with GitHub, Hugging Face, npm, and crates.io; license extraction, and provenance tracking.
part_9_resource_discovery.regression_risks: Upstream rate-limit exhaustion causing empty explorer responses.

part_10_database_reliability.focus: PostgreSQL schema validation, durable job persistence, lease ownership, and restart recovery.
part_10_database_reliability.regression_risks: Database lock contention during automated schema migrations.

part_11_gui_rework.focus: Restrained engineering aesthetic (#080B10, #121822, #42D9F5), zero-pill typographic discipline, responsive mobile navigation (320px-1440px), and clear action mappings for every button.
part_11_gui_rework.regression_risks: Breaking modal or view navigation routes.
part_11_gui_rework.required_tests: Run npm run lint and compile_applet.

part_12_production_readiness.focus: Final end-to-end audit, defect triage, full test suite pass, and zero-defect deployment validation.
part_12_production_readiness.regression_risks: Discrepancy between staging environment and serverless production runtime.
part_12_production_readiness.required_tests: Run npm test, npm run lint, and npm run build.
